Timing

Shirts ship from our supplier once your order is confirmed. Delivery takes 12 to 25 days depending on destination and customs. Personalised shirts add two days before dispatch because the print is done to order.

Tracking

You get a tracking number by email as soon as the parcel moves. If tracking has not updated in seven days, write to us and we will chase it.

Customs

Orders outside Israel may attract import duty on arrival. That charge is set by your country, not by us, and is not included in the price you pay here.
